howToUse: Visit each route (web) or screen (Expo web), take document.body.innerText (plus title/aria-label/placeholder/tooltip text where you can), and test each pattern with new RegExp(regex, flags). Severity 'error' fails the test. 'warn' is reported for a human to review. Patterns with scope 'mobile' or 'web' run only there. roleChecks are Playwright locator checks.

patterns.why: Raw ISO date/timestamp. Use the packages/core formatter ('Thu 15 Oct').
UUID shown to the user.
8-hex UUID fragment used as a name or title (e.g. 'Trainee 9035c4ad', shortId()).
Raw enum (overdue_meal, portion_size, upper_back, steps_enabled). Map it through packages/core labels.
Greeting removed (TW-04).
The nav and H1 label is 'Templates' (TW-03/TW-23).
Sidebar status claim removed (TW-03).
Dev placeholder copy (e.g. 'TR-21 placeholder').
Spec IDs in UI. The only exception is the support mailto subject, which isn't rendered.
Negative relative time. Clamp to 'just now'.
mm/dd/yyyy or dd/mm/yyyy. Use 'Thu 15 Oct'.
US long date ('Sunday, October 18'). Use 'Sun 18 Oct'.
Internal snapshot label with a UUID (PlanCompositionEditor).
No % scores, adherence or completion rates.
No streaks (§1.5).

patterns.regex: Live Sync|Dropout Risk|Photo Proof|Priority Trainer Queue|Day Streak|Compliance
patterns.why: Banned Figma elements (§1.5).

patterns.regex: mvp\.v2|No gamification|Selected role|\bdeterministic\b|outside FitBud|Trainee daily execution|LOCAL_DEV_ERROR|Invalid datetime|\[object Object\]|\bundefined\b|\bNaN\b|\bnull\b
patterns.why: Developer and internal copy leaking into the UI.
The guide labels the support entry 'Help' (mailto tech@thefitbud.com). Check it against the screen spec.
Unscaled nutrient (400000000 kcal; NUTRIENT_SCALE = 1e6).
Unbounded duration (29068 min).
Name not title-cased ('ishita pushoff', 'rahul coach'). Case-sensitive. Emails are excluded by the look-arounds.
FitBud never knows a wa.me message was sent. It says 'Opened WhatsApp'.
Times are 'h:mm am/pm'. 24 h values appear in some guide AC (quiet hours); see BATCHES.md Spec questions.

roleChecks.why: Mobile lists use pull-to-refresh (Screen onRefresh), never a Refresh button.
The web check-in and history lists had manual Refresh buttons. Realtime is a refetch hint (TW-04 §7). Check it against the screen spec.
